summary: Student results (literal Excel import) feature tested end-to-end. Backend 11/11 pytest + manual empty-levels check pass: xlsx/csv import, upsert by (reg_no+level) with no duplicates, header/blank rows ignored, rows missing reg/level reported in skipped_rows, values literal ('88.4','58.30','3.93','دور ثان'), empty -> null, Arabic level words ('الثالث'->3), 400 on garbage/no valid rows, permissions (student 403 on admin endpoints, admin 403 on /students/me/results, unauth 401/403), delete + 404. /students/me/results for 1001 returns levels sorted [1,2]; returns {levels:[]} 200 after deleting rows (rows then restored from /tmp/r2.xlsx). Frontend: admin login -> dashboard tile 'نتائج الطلاب (التطبيق)' navigates to /student-results; list, upload (success message), search, delete with confirm all work.

minor.issue: Numeric Excel cells lose display formatting (a cell typed as number 58.30 is stored '58.3'; percentages/fixed decimals not preserved). Only text-formatted cells are truly literal. Consider reading cell.number_format or advising text format in template (template already sets '@').
